title: Support Console: Merging Duplicate Conversations
author: Owen Phillips
body:
## Purpose
Customers often open a second conversation about an issue they already raised, by email and chat at once. This page covers merging those conversations. Duplicate charges on an invoice are a different thing; see the credits and disputes page.

## When to merge
- Same customer, same issue, both conversations open.
- Keep the older conversation and merge the newer one into it.
- Don't merge conversations from different orgs, even if the issue is identical.

## After merging
- Reply once, in the kept conversation, and say the other one was merged.
- A case already opened from either conversation stays as it is; don't open a second case for the same issue.

_Last reviewed 2027-02-10._
